from hermes_tools import terminal
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u057/system/state/workspace/programs/task-7ca619de.py'
code = r'''import importlib.util,json
p="''' + p + r'''"
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("task",p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
demo=[[0]*16 for _ in range(16)]; demo[4][11]=3; demo[10][3]=3
out=m.transform(demo)
expected=[[0]*16 for _ in range(16)]
for r,c in [(4,11),(10,3)]:
    for dc in range(-2,3): expected[r-2][c+dc]=5
    for dr in (-1,0,1):
        for dc in (-2,2): expected[r+dr][c+dc]=2
    expected[r-1][c]=5
    for cc in range(16): expected[r+2][cc]=8 if c-2<=cc<=c+2 else 2
    expected[r][c]=3
print("DEMO_MATCH",out==expected)
test=[[0]*19 for _ in range(17)]
for r,c in [(3,4),(8,11),(13,6)]: test[r][c]=3
print(json.dumps(m.transform(test)))
'''
r=terminal('python3 -c '+__import__('shlex').quote(code),timeout=30)
print(r['output'])
